title: ServingPreset
description: A curated recipe for serving one model on the platform's llm-d serving path. The chart ships a reviewed set (files/model-serving/presets/) and publishes each preset in effect as a ConfigMap in the release namespace (label agent-platform.giantswarm.io/serving-preset=true, key preset.yaml); modelServing.presets adds or replaces presets. model-manager composes a published preset into an LLMInferenceService on the well-known LLMInferenceServiceConfigs; it never invents vLLM flags. Authoring form and published form share this schema: publishing fills the defaults noted below and resolves chatTemplate to the ConfigMap that holds it.

name.description: Lowercase DNS-1123 label, at most 30 characters. Names the preset ConfigMap (agent-platform-serving-preset-<name>), its chat-template ConfigMap (agent-platform-chat-template-<name>) and, by default, the LLMInferenceService composed from it.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the portal.

description.description: Notes for the operator: what the model is good at, the hardware the recipe was tuned on, known limits. Markdown.

id.description: Hugging Face repository (owner/name); the cache inventory and the import flow key on it.

storageUri.description: The LLMInferenceService's model URI. hf://<id> downloads through the KServe storage-initializer (into the cache when the Kyverno policies are on); pvc://<claim>/<dir> serves pre-warmed weights without a download; oci://<registry>/<path>[:tag|@digest] is a model image (KServe's modelcar path).

format.description: The model format, informational on the llm-d path (the well-known template serves vLLM). Published presets always carry it.

contextLength.description: Context window in tokens the recipe serves (informational; --max-model-len in args is authoritative).

capabilities.description: Informational tags, e.g. chat, tools, reasoning, vision, coding, embeddings.

license.description: SPDX identifier or the model card's license name.

args.description: vLLM server arguments appended to the well-known template's, complete and literal. The template re-parses every argument through a shell (eval "… $@"), so outside single quotes an argument carries no whitespace, quote or shell metacharacter; a value that needs them is single-quoted inside one argument: --default-chat-template-kwargs='{"enable_thinking": false}'. Do not pass --chat-template: publishing appends it from chatTemplate.

env.description: Extra environment of the runtime container (Kubernetes EnvVar).

chatTemplate.description: A chat template that replaces the model's own. Authoring: exactly one of file (shipped under files/model-serving/chat-templates/), content (inline) or existingConfigMap (pre-created in the serving namespace). Published: configMap names the ConfigMap in the serving namespace to mount at mountPath, and args ends with --chat-template=<mountPath>/<key>.

resources.description: Resources of the runtime container. gpus is requested and limited as modelServing.serving.gpuResourceName; requests/limits are merged over the well-known template's envelope.

requirements.description: Memory the recipe needs on the serving node: weights plus the KV cache, activations and runtime overhead. The portal's fit check compares weightsGiB + overheadGiB with the node's GPU (or unified) memory.

weightsGiB.description: Size of the weights as served (after quantization).

overheadGiB.description: Headroom for KV cache, activations, CUDA graphs and the runtime.

scheduling.description: Placement of the model pod on top of modelServing.serving: nodeSelector is merged over the component default; publishing merges the GPU pool's toleration and selector (modelServing.gpuPool) under it.

template.description: Extra LLMInferenceService template fields copied verbatim. A preset names no image: the model pod runs the runtime image the well-known LLMInferenceServiceConfig names (components.kserve-runtime-configs); an image here is the exception and states its reason in description.
